def interval_leaf(box, l):
    # box: list of (lo,hi) per position; embedding on summed one-hot
    lo = [sum(min(Eq[o][t] for t in range(r[0], r[1]+1)) for r in box) for o in range(4)]
    hi = [sum(max(Eq[o][t] for t in range(r[0], r[1]+1)) for r in box) for o in range(4)]

    lo2 = [sum(min(Lq[o][i]*lo[i], Lq[o][i]*hi[i]) for i in range(4)) for o in range(4)]
    hi2 = [sum(max(Lq[o][i]*lo[i], Lq[o][i]*hi[i]) for i in range(4)) for o in range(4)]
    # margins at output

    return ok, [float(x) for x in m]

inductive Term where
  | diag (m : Nat)
  | pair (a m : Nat) (wd : Bool)

def termOk (cols : List Nat) : Term → Bool
  | .diag m => decide (m < 8) && decide (m ∈ cols)
  | .pair a m _ => decide (a < m) && decide (m < 8) && decide (a ∈ cols) && decide (m ∈ cols)

def planOk (p : List Nat) : Bool :=
  decide (p.length < 8) && decide p.Nodup

example (cols : List Nat) (m : Nat) (hok : termOk cols (.diag m) = true) : m < 8 := by
  simp only [termOk, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok
  exact hok.1

example (cols : List Nat) (m : Nat) (hok : termOk cols (.diag m) = true) : m < 8 := by
  unfold termOk at hok
  simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok
  exact hok.1

example (cols : List Nat) (t : Term) (hok : termOk cols t = true) : True := by
  cases t with
  | diag m =>
    simp only [termOk, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok
    trivial
  | pair a m wd =>
    simp only [termOk, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok
    trivial

open Classical in
example (cols : List Nat) (t : Term) (hok : termOk cols t = true) : True := by
  cases t with
  | diag m =>
    simp only [termOk, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok
    trivial
  | pair a m wd =>
    simp only [termOk, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok
    trivial

open Classical in
example (cols : List Nat) (t : Term) (hok : termOk cols t = true) : True := by
  cases t with
  | diag m =>
    have hok' : (decide (m < 8) && decide (m ∈ cols)) = true := hok
    simp only [Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hok'
    trivial
  | pair a m wd =>
    trivial

example (p : List Nat) (hp : planOk p = true) : p.length < 8 := by
  simp only [planOk, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hp
